data.description: A formian possesses the darkvision 60 feet and blindsense 30 feet. &nl; Formians have telepathy 60 ft. &nl; When formians are within telepathic range of at least one other formian, they gain +4 on initiative and Perception checks and if one disbelieves an illusion, all within range do as well. &nl; Formian spellcasters cast spells as spell-like abilities. &nl; Formians have sonic resistance 10.
